thread:
Elena (Docs): Quick announcement — SDK v4.1 will start rolling out tomorrow 09:00 PT. Two items to watch: default for `strict_output` flips to true, and the old `open_session` param is officially deprecated. See migration guide linked below.

Ashwin (Eng-runtime): Thanks Elena. quick note — the `strict_output` flip improves safety for streaming/chat but will break a few internal flows that expect unstructured tails. We added a per-route override and a compatibility shim for 60 days.

Kevin (DevEx): Migration checklist published in the docs repo. TL;DR: search for `strict_output` in your codebase, update tests, and pin clients if you need stable behavior. I'll run a repo-wide grep and open PRs for obvious matches.

Maria Chen (Support): Can we get a short FAQ for CS? Customers already asked about "responses changed formatting" in the beta. I can paste a canned response.

Elena (Docs): Yes — FAQ and canned replies are in the guide. docs-bot will post the public docs URL once it's live. For internal: use this one: https://intranet.redwood/docs/sdk-v4.1-migration (internal only).

docs-bot: Migration guide uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/docs/sdk-v4.1-migration — includes code samples, rollout timeline, and a small CLI tool `rw-migrate --check` to highlight likely breakage.

Kevin (DevEx): Example snippet we'll add to examples page:
```js
// old
await client.generate({ model: "rw-1", strict_output: false })
// new (default)
await client.generate({ model: "rw-1" }) // strict_output defaults to true
```

Ashwin (Eng-runtime): Runtime note for infra teams: default tokenization path is unchanged, but we tightened response truncation behaviour. If you rely on exact trailing tokens, pin `strict_output: false` for now; we'll auto-telemetry flagged endpoints and suggest batching changes.

Linus (CTO): Appreciate the heads-up. Two asks: (1) schedule a 30m sync for product+support tomorrow 10:00 PT to cover customer-facing language, (2) set canary region to us-west-2 only for first 24h.

Elena (Docs): Added CANARY note to the rollout plan. Rollout schedule: canary us-west-2 09:00 PT -> 6h monitor -> gradated 20% -> 50% -> full in 48h if no regressions. Deprecation: `open_session` marked deprecated today, removal planned in 60 days.

Maria Chen (Support): Copy that. I'll queue the canned replies and add an internal ticket template for affected customers.

deploy-bot: v4.1 rollout scheduled: canary us-west-2 @ 1729040400. Watch: #eng-runtime for realtime alerts.

Kevin (DevEx): If anyone wants early access to the migration CLI, ping me and I'll add you to the canary group.

Elena (Docs): Thanks all — main doc link again: https://intranet.redwood/docs/sdk-v4.1-migration. Please report any surprises in the thread or open an issue in the docs repo. :thumbsup:
